description: This file defines the SetCookie class used for parsing, representing, and managing HTTP cookies within the GuzzleHttp client library. It includes methods for creating cookies from strings, setting and retrieving cookie attributes, and checking domain/path matching and expiration.

classes.name: SetCookie
classes.description: Represents an HTTP cookie with attributes such as name, value, domain, path, expiration, security flags, and provides methods for parsing, validation, and matching against request attributes.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a SetCookie object from a Set-Cookie header string by parsing its components into attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SetCookie object with provided cookie data, setting default values and computing expiration if necessary.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Serializes the cookie object back into a string suitable for HTTP headers.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the cookie attributes as an associative array.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the cookie's name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the cookie's name.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the cookie's value.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the cookie's value.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Returns the cookie's domain.

methods.name: setDomain
methods.description: Sets the cookie's domain.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the cookie's path.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the cookie's path.

methods.name: getMaxAge
methods.description: Returns the max-age of the cookie.

methods.name: setMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the max-age of the cookie.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Returns the expiration timestamp of the cookie.

methods.name: setExpires
methods.description: Sets the expiration timestamp of the cookie.

methods.name: getSecure
methods.description: Indicates whether the cookie is secure.

methods.name: setSecure
methods.description: Sets the secure flag.

methods.name: getDiscard
methods.description: Indicates whether the cookie is a discard (session) cookie.

methods.name: setDiscard
methods.description: Sets the discard flag.

methods.name: getHttpOnly
methods.description: Indicates whether the cookie is HTTP only.

methods.name: setHttpOnly
methods.description: Sets the HTTP only flag.

methods.name: matchesPath
methods.description: Checks if the cookie matches a given request path.

methods.name: matchesDomain
methods.description: Checks if the cookie matches a given domain.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the cookie has expired.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the cookie attributes according to RFC 6265.
